name: Lexington
text: Lexington is a suburban town in Middlesex County, Massachusetts, United States, located 10 miles (16 km) from Downtown Boston. The population was 34,454 as of the 2020 census. The area was originally inhabited by Native Americans, and was first settled by Europeans c.

depictions.name: Lexington
depictions.text: Lexington, Massachusetts Lexington is a town in the Frontier located near Boston, Massachusetts. In 1775, it was the site of the first battle of the American Revolutionary War.
